title: config: DkimConfig derives Default producing invalid zero-value
description: DkimConfig derives Default, which produces all-empty strings for domain, selector, key_seed_b64, and public_key_b64 -- a value that fails validate() immediately. The Default impl exists solely to satisfy serde(default) on Option<DkimConfig> which does not require DkimConfig to implement Default. Idiomatic Rust: drop the derive Default; Option<T> with serde(default) needs no Default on T.
